'''Kenichi Suzumura''' (Japanese: '''鈴村健一''' ''Suzumura Ken'ichi'') is a Japanese voice actor for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Suzumura was born on September 12, 1974, in {{wp|Niigata Prefecture}}, {{wp|Japan}}, but was raised in {{wp|Osaka Prefecture}}. He became a voice actor as an adult and eventually got a number of significant roles in Japanese anime series. Suzumura joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|GS}}, but got his most notable role in that work, [[Hoenn]] {{pkmn|Champion}} [[Steven Stone]], during {{aniseries|XY}}, replacing Rintarō Nishi. In addition to performing voice acting roles, Suzumura has also dubbed a multitude of roles in international films and shows, both live-action and animated. He was once affiliated with the talent agency {{wp|Arts Vision}}, but he eventually left and founded his own agency, INTENTION, on May 8, 2009. He married a fellow voice actress, {{wp|Maaya Sakamoto}}, on August 8, 2011. Suzumura and Sakamoto announced they were expecting their first child on December 27, 2021. Their first child was born on April 21, 2022.
